title: To Nothing Zine Vol. 01
author_sort: Pramudiya, Awe & Amethyst & Disperarii, Jurang & Shesha & Volver
comment: Life is paradoxical. We come from nothing. We'll go back to nothing. But between in those two, there is a space of being nothing, which is life. I believe that being nothing is the most honest condition existence. We want to dwell with nothingness gracefully and still be able to fall in love with the remnants of light.
